title: Withholding Tax Defaults: Mitigating Section 234E Fees & TRACES Corrections
summary: Handling quarterly e-TDS returns (24Q, 26Q), Section 194T/194C rates, TRACES revisions, and Form 26QB property sale deductions.
body:
Failure to deposit tax deducted at source or submit quarterly returns triggers daily financial penalties under Section 234E.

Monitor active TRACES filing cutoffs on our [TDS due date tracker](/compliance) or visit our [TDS return filing checklist](/compliance).

Promptly correcting default notices prevents Section 271H penalty proceedings. Contact our desk to [schedule a consultation](/schedule) for TRACES revision support.
